subject: WOOD
title: Integrated Forest Management
description: The study of silviculture and silvics and their application to forest management to sustain the production of wood and other ecological goods and services such as wildlife, water and landscape in natural forests and rural environments (agroforestry). Acquisition of practical skills in forest surveying and computer simulation of forest growth.

prerequisites.text: ENVB 210 or ENVB 222 or ENVR 202, or permission of instructor.
